strings.aNo: Umastrasi nguye othatha isigqibo. Ukusebenzisa inFORMed akuqinisekisi ukuba inkundla iza kuwunika umyalelo, okanye ukuba amapolisa aza kuqinisekisa ukuba uyalandelwa.
strings.aS1: Thatha ifomu yakho uye nayo kwi-clerk of the court, umntu osebenza eofisini yenkundla, nakweyiphi na iMagistrates' Court. Yiya ngexesha lokusebenza kwenkundla (ngokuqhelekileyo ukususela ngo-9am ukuya ku-3:30pm phakathi evekini). Ukuba usengozini, ungafaka isicelo nasemva kweeyure zokusebenza. Kusimahla, kwaye awudingi gqwetha.
strings.aS2: I-clerk of the court ijonga ifomu kunye nawe. Uyisayina phambi kwe-commissioner of oaths, umntu ogunyazisiweyo ukuba akubone xa ufunga kwaye usayina.
strings.aS3: Umastrasi uyayifunda, kaninzi kwangolo suku. Ukuba umastrasі ubona ukuba udinga ukukhuselwa ngoku, ukunika i-interim protection order, umyalelo wokukukhusela okwethutyana.
strings.aS4: Isherifu okanye amapolisa amnika lo myalelo wethutyana. Ukukhusela ukususela ngexesha awufumana ngalo.
strings.aS5: Unikwa i-return date, usuku ekufuneka ubuyele ngalo enkundleni. Ngaloo mini nobabini ningaya enkundleni, aze umastrasі athathe isigqibo sokuba akunike na umyalelo wokukhusela wokugqibela. Qiniseka ukuba uya enkundleni ngalo mhla.
strings.aS6: Ukuba uyawophula umyalelo, xela kwisikhululo samapolisa osibhale kwifomu yakho. Usenokubanjwa.
strings.aTitle: Kwenzeka ntoni emva kokuba ugqibe ifomu yakho
strings.aboutG1: GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech) ngumbutho waseMzantsi Afrika olwela amalungelo abantu basetyhini nosebenzisa iteknoloji. Usebenzisa iteknoloji ukuxhasa abantu abasinde kubundlobongela obusekelwe kwisini, nokunceda abantu bafumane ulwazi, inkxaso nezixhobo ezimalunga namalungelo abo, impilo nokuphila kakuhle.
strings.aboutI1: inFORMed sisixhobo se GRIT esisebenzisa i-AI ukunceda abantu baqonde indlela yokufumana uncedo lwezomthetho. Sithetha njengomntu onenkathalo ekuhlaleni, asingxamisi okanye sigwebe mntu. Sinceda abantu abajongene nobundlobongela basekhaya ukuba babhale amava abo kwisicelo enokuthatha amanyathelo ngaso inkundla.
strings.aboutI2: Isikhokelo saso sisekelwe kwifomu esemthethweni yokufaka isicelo se-protection order, umyalelo wenkundla wokukukhusela. Sisekelwe nakwizikhokelo ezimalunga namalungelo abantu abajongene nobundlobongela basekhaya nezimalunga nokubhala isicelo esomeleleyo, kuphando lwe MOSAIC ngezinto ezijongwa ngoomantyi, nakwisikhokelo se GRIT se-protection order.
strings.askDesc: Qonda ii-protection order, inkqubo yenkundla namagama asemthethweni.
strings.askOpening: Molo, ndingu-inFORMed. Ndiyinkqubo ye-AI encokolayo, andingomntu. Andikwazi ukunika iingcebiso zomthetho. Ndingakucacisela ukuba zisebenza njani ii-protection order (imiyalelo yenkundla yokukhusela), athetha ntoni amagama omthetho nokuba ungalindela ntoni enkundleni. Ungathanda ukwazi ntoni?

strings.bringA4: Naziphi na ii-protection order ezindala, iinombolo zamatyala asemapoliseni (CAS) okanye ze-OB
strings.bringNote: Usenokwenza isicelo nokuba awunazo ezi zinto. Yiza neekopi uze ugcine ezokuqala kwindawo ekhuselekileyo.

strings.fillOpening:
Molo, ndingu-inFORMed. Ndiyinkqubo ye-AI encokolayo, andingomntu. Andikwazi ukunika iingcebiso zomthetho.

Ndingakunceda ugcwalise ifomu ye-protection order (umyalelo wenkundla wokukhusela).

✔ Ibali lakho lisetyenziselwa ifomu yakho kuphela.
✔ Ukhetha ngokwakho ukuba ufuna ukwabelana ngantoni.
✔ Ifomu yakho iyagcwaliseka njengoko sincokola, ngoko ubalisa ibali lakho kube kanye kuphela.
✔ Cofa u-QUICK EXIT ukuze uphume ngokukhawuleza.

Usengozini ngoku? Fowunela u-10111.
strings.fillStart:
Ndixelele ukuba kwenzeka ntoni. Ungachwetheza okanye uthethe.

Umzekelo: “Owayesakuba liqabane lam usoloko endisongela. Ndifuna angasondeli kum.”
strings.footNote: inFORMed ikunceda ulungiselele isicelo sakho somyalelo wokhuseleko. Ayililo icebiso lezomthetho kwaye ayithathi indawo kanobhala wenkundla okanye yegqwetha.
strings.footPw: Ixhaswa yi-GRIT · Gender Rights in Tech
strings.g1: Ukubeka abasindileyo phambili nokuqonda ifuthe lokwenzakala engqondweni nasemoyeni, ngokubeka ukhuseleko neemfuno zabasindileyo phambili kwitek­noloji nakwiinkqubo zayo.
strings.g2: Ukuyila kunye noluntu, kuquka abasetyhini abasebatsha, abasindileyo nabantu abanamava anceda ekuyilweni kwezixhobo.
strings.g3: Inkxaso yedijithali efikeleleka lula, kuquka i-Zuzi, isixhobo sokuncokola esisebenzisa i-AI kwi-app ye GRIT, kunye nenkxaso kuWhatsApp nezinye izixhobo zedijithali.
strings.g4: Iindlela eziluncedo zokufumana ukhuseleko nenkxaso, kuquka izinto ezikwi-app ye GRIT ezifana ne Panic Button neqonga lokugcina ubungqina, i-Evidence Vault.
strings.generalInfo: Olu lulwazi nje ngokubanzi, aluveli kwizikhokelo ze-GRIT. Nceda uqinisekise kunobhala wenkundla.
strings.guideAudio: Wamkelekile ku-inFORMed, evela kwa-GRIT. Le webhusayithi ikunceda ugcwalise ifomu yenkundla ye-protection order (umyalelo wenkundla wokukukhusela). Isimahla kwaye yeyabucala. Ukuqalisa, cofa iqhosha elikhulu elizuba elithi: Qalisa ifomu yam. Emva koko balisa ibali lakho. Akunyanzelekanga ubhale. Cofa umbhobho ozuba uthethe, uze uwucofe kwakhona xa ugqibile. Emva koko cofa u-Yimamele ukuze umamele oko kuviweyo, uze ucofe u-Thumela ukuba kuchanekile, okanye u-Yitsho kwakhona. Ukuba uvula u-Funda ngokuvakalayo, yonke impendulo uza kuyifundelwa. Ukuba usengozini ngoku, fowunela amapolisa ku-1 0 1 1 1, okanye ucofe iqhosha elibomvu lokuphuma ngokukhawuleza eliphezulu ukuze uphume ngokukhawuleza kule sayithi.
strings.h1: Gcwalisa ifomu yakho yeprotection order ngoncedo.
strings.hSadag: Umnxeba we-SADAG wabantu abasengxakini yokufuna ukuzibulala, iiyure eziyi-24
strings.hTg: Ncokola ne-inFORMed, chwetheza okanye uthumele imiyalezo yelizwi
strings.hfIntro: Nasi isicelo sakho, sifundwa ngokuvakalayo. Yile nto uza kuyifungela enkundleni. Ungacofa u-Stop nanini na. Ukuba kukho into engalunganga okanye eshiyiweyo, ndixelele apha kwincoko, okanye uyitshintshe kwifomu.
strings.howSub: Oomantyi bafuna iinkcukacha ezithile nezicacileyo ukuze banike i-protection order. inFORMed ikunceda uzinike, ngaphandle kokuba incoko ivakale ngathi ugcwalisa ifomu.
strings.iP1: inFORMed yinkqubo yokuncokola ye-AI eyenziwe yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Asingomntu kwaye asilogqwetha, yaye ayiniki ngcebiso ngezomthetho. Ikunceda ulungiselele idrafti yefomu esemthethweni yenkundla. Unobhala wenkundla eMagistrates' Court uyijonga kunye nawe ngaphambi kokuba uyisayine.
strings.iP2: Ukuze ikuphendule, inFORMed ithumela imiyalezo yakho ku-OpenAI, inkampani ene-AI eyisebenzisayo. GRIT ayiyiboni okanye iyigcine imiyalezo yakho. U-OpenAI ucelwa ukuba angayigcini, kwaye ayisetyenziselwa ukuqeqesha nayiphi na i-AI.
strings.iP3: Incoko ayigcinwa kwaphela: iyaphela xa uvala iphepha. Ifomu yakho igcinwa kule fowuni kuphela, kwiphepha elivuliweyo, ukuze ingalahleki xa ulivula ngokutsha iphepha. Ukuba ukhetha u-“Save to finish later”, itshixwa nge-PIN oyikhethayo kwaye ihlala kule fowuni de uyicime. Akukho mntu unokuyivula ngaphandle kwe-PIN, nkqu no-GRIT. Ukuba uyilibele i-PIN, ayinakufunyanwa kwakhona.
strings.iP4: Cofa u-Start over okanye u-Quick exit ukucima okukwiphepha. Ukucima ifomu egciniweyo, cofa u-“Continue a saved application” kwiphepha lokuqala, faka i-PIN yakho uze ukhethe u-“Delete it”. Ifayile ye-PDF okanye ye-WORD oyikhupheleyo ihlala kwiifayile ezikhutshelweyo zefowuni yakho de uyicime.
strings.iP5: Omnye umntu osebenzisa le fowuni angabona kwimbali yebrawuza ukuba ubukhe waya ku-inFORMed, okanye afumane ifomu oyikhupheleyo. Ukuba loo nto ingakubeka emngciphekweni, sebenzisa ithebhu yabucala (incognito), cima iifayile ozikhupheleyo emva kokuzisebenzisa, uze ucime imbali yebrawuza yakho. Ifomu egcinwe nge-PIN ihlala itshixiwe. Kwithebhu yabucala, ifomu egciniweyo iyalahleka xa uvala ithebhu.
strings.iP6: Tsalela amapolisa ku-10111 okanye i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428. Zombini zisimahla. Ungasebenzisa ne-app ye-GRIT, eneqhosha likaxakeka elikuqhagamshela kuncedo.
strings.k1: Ungasifaka ngokwakho isicelo se-protection order, umyalelo wenkundla wokukukhusela, simahla. Awudingi gqwetha, kwaye akufuneki uvule ityala emapoliseni kuqala.
strings.k2: Ufaka isicelo e Magistrates' Court apho uhlala khona, usebenza okanye ufunda khona, apho omnye umntu ahlala okanye asebenza khona, okanye apho kwenzeke khona ukuxhatshazwa.
strings.k2s: Iinkundla zidla ngokuvulwa ukusuka ngo 9am ukuya ku 3:30pm phakathi evekini. Ukuba usengozini ungafaka isicelo nasemva kweeyure zokusebenza.
strings.k3: Ubundlobongela basekhaya abupheleli nje ekwenzakaliseni umzimba. Buquka ukuxhatshazwa ngokweemvakalelo, ngemali nangokwesondo, ukukukhathaza, ukukoyikisa nokuzama ukulawula ubomi bakho.
strings.k4: Iifoto, amanqaku kagqirha okanye amangqina anganceda, kodwa usengasifaka isicelo ngaphandle kwazo. Nomntwana wayo nayiphi na iminyaka angasifaka isicelo.
strings.knowSub: Oku kuvela kwizikhokelo esekelwe kuzo i-inFORMed.
strings.learnH: Ufuna ukwazi ngakumbi ngaphambi kokuba uqalise?
strings.learnP: Buza nantoni na nge-protection order (umyalelo wenkundla wokukukhusela), inkundla, okanye amagama asemthethweni. Bhala okanye uthethe, kwaye ungamamela yonke impendulo.

strings.restoredPin: Ibuyisiwe. Ukuze uhlale uhlaziya ikopi yakho egcinwe ngePIN, khetha “Gcina ukuze ugqibezele kamva” kwakhona.
strings.s1d: Balisa okwenzekileyo ngamazwi akho nangolwimi lwakho. inFORMed ibuza umbuzo omnye ngexesha, ngobubele. Ungayeka nanini na ufuna.
strings.s2d: Inkcukacha nganye ingena kwindawo yayo kwifomu yenkundla. Ibhalwa ngendlela oomantyi abafuna ukuyifunda ngayo: imihla, iindawo, into eyathethwayo, nendlela izinto eziye zaba mbi ngayo.

strings.safety.death: Ndiyichatbot, kwaye oku kuvakala ngathi yimeko kaxakeka efuna uncedo lomntu. Ukuba unalo ixesha lokucinga ngendlela yokuphuma engozini, ndibuze ngesicwangciso sokuzikhusela. Ukuba yimeko kaxakeka kwaye udinga uncedo ngoku, fowunela iambulensi ku-10177 okanye amapolisa ku-10111. Ezi nombolo zisimahla, ngoko awudingi airtime. Ungakhuphela ne-app ye-GRIT eza kukudibanisa noncedo usebenzisa eli khonkco: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele okanye iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.fallback: Uxolo, ndibe nengxaki yokuphendula ngoku. Ukuba usengozini, tsalela amapolisa ku-10111, okanye i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (simahla, iiyure eziyi-24). Nceda uzame ukuthumela umyalezo wakho kwakhona.
strings.safety.goodbye: Ukuba uneminye imibuzo nangaliphi na ixesha, nceda ubuye uze ubuze. Ndilapha ukukunceda nanini na undidinga. Usale kakuhle okwangoku!
strings.safety.harm_other: Kufuneka ukuba ubuhlungu kakhulu ukuze uzive ngale ndlela. Ndiyichatbot, ngoko andisoloko ndiyazi indlela yokuqonda iimvakalelo zabantu. Iqela le-GRIT liyakwazi ukunceda ngeemvakalelo ezinzima nezibuhlungu. Nceda ubathumelele umyalezo kuWhatsApp ku-072 737 8819.
strings.safety.immediate_danger: Ndiyichatbot, kwaye le nto ivakala ngathi yimeko engxamisekileyo efuna uncedo lomntu. Ukuba unalo ixesha lokucwangcisa indlela yokuphuma engozini, ndibuze ngesicwangciso sokhuseleko. Ukuba yimeko engxamisekileyo kwaye ufuna uncedo ngoku, tsalela iambulensi ku-10177 okanye amapolisa ku-10111. Ezi nombolo zisimahla, ngoko awuyidingi iairtime. Ungayikhuphela neapp ye-GRIT, eya kukudibanisa noncedo, usebenzisa eli khonkco: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele okanye iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.injured_now: Ndiyichatbot, kwaye oku kuvakala ngathi yimeko kaxakeka efuna uncedo lomntu. Ukuba unalo ixesha lokucinga ngendlela yokuphuma engozini, ndibuze ngesicwangciso sokuzikhusela. Ukuba yimeko kaxakeka kwaye udinga uncedo ngoku, fowunela iambulensi ku-10177 okanye amapolisa ku-10111. Ezi nombolo zisimahla, ngoko awudingi airtime.
strings.safety.rape: Akukho mntu ufanele adlule kule nto udlula kuyo. Ayilotyala lakho. Ndingakunceda njani?
strings.safety.suicidal: Ndiyaxolisa kakhulu ukuba uziva ufuna ukuzibulala, kodwa ndivuya kakhulu ukuba uzive unokuthetha ngako. Andingomntu, ngoko ndingangakwazi ukukuxhasa ngendlela eqonda ngokupheleleyo le nto ukuyo. Nantsi inombolo ye-SADAG. Awudingi airtime ukuze ufowune, kwaye umntu angakuxhasa 24/7. Inombolo yabo ngu-0800 567 567. Ungajonga newebhusayithi yabo: https://www.sadag.org
strings.safety.support: Ukuba ufuna ukuthetha nomntu ngoku, i-GBV Command Centre isimahla kwaye ivuliwe iiyure eziyi-24: 0800 428 428. Ungathumela no-WhatsApp kwi-GRIT ku-072 737 8819. Singanqumama nanini na ufuna.
strings.safety.tracking: Andiniki mntu iinkcukacha zakho. Incoko yethu ayigcinwa emva kokuba uyivalile.
strings.saveDemo: Ukugcina kusebenza kwincoko yokwenyani, hayi kumboniso.
strings.saveKept: Ifomu yakho iyagcinwa ukuba iphepha liphinda livuleke.
strings.savedPinGo: Igcinwe kwesi sixhobo ngePIN yakho. Izinto ozitshintshayo ziyagcinwa njengoko uqhubeka.
strings.serverErr: Uxolo, khange ndikwazi ukuqhagamshelana neseva ngoku. Nceda uzame kwakhona. Ukuba usengozini, fowunela u-10111 okanye i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428.
strings.sug3: Kwenzeka ntoni emva kokuba ndifake isicelo?
strings.toAsk: Ndibuze nantoni na malunga neeprotection order, imiyalelo yenkundla yokukukhusela. Ifomu yakho igciniwe, kwaye ungabuyela kuyo nangaliphi na ixesha.
strings.toFill: Masiqhubeke nesicelo sakho. Ifomu yakho igcinwe ngasekunene.
strings.typesNone: Iintlobo zokuxhatshazwa ziza kuvela apha njengoko kuthethwa ngazo.
strings.underDemo: Umzekelo: ngumntu owenziweyo kunye nencoko ebhalwe kwangaphambili.
strings.underLive: Incoko yakho iyimfihlo. Incoko ayigcinwa, kodwa ifomu yakho iyagcinwa ukuba iphepha liphinda lilayishe.
strings.vCheck: Jonga into endiyivileyo uze utshintshe nantoni na ofuna ukuyitshintsha. Emva koko cofa ukuthumela.
strings.vFail: Uxolo, khange ndiyive kakuhle loo nto. Nceda uzame kwakhona, okanye uchwetheze endaweni yoko.
strings.vListen: Ndimamele… cofa imakrofoni ebomvu xa ugqibile.
strings.vListenT: Ndimamele… {t}. Cofa imakrofoni ebomvu xa ugqibile.
strings.vNear: Simamele… {t}. Sele kusondele 3 imizuzu: cofa umbhobho obomvu kungekudala. Ungarekhoda okungakumbi emva koko.
strings.vNoSupport: Uxolo, awukwazi ukusebenzisa ilizwi kwesi sikhangeli. Nceda uchwetheze endaweni yoko.
strings.vPerm: Ndifuna imvume yokusebenzisa imakrofoni yakho. Ungayivumela kwisikhangeli sakho, okanye uchwetheze endaweni yoko.
strings.vQ: Yile nto uyithethileyo? Ungawatshintsha amagama, okanye uwamamele.
strings.wa.askMore: Ungabhala okanye uthumele umyalezo welizwi. Xa ufuna uncedo ngesicelo sakho, thumela {fill}.
strings.wa.code: Wamkelekile kwi-inFORMed, eqhutywa yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Nceda uthumele ikhowudi yokungena oyinikiweyo.
strings.wa.docFail: Uxolo, andikwazanga ukuthumela uxwebhu ngoku. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
strings.wa.general: — Le yinkcazelo jikelele, ayiphumi kwizikhokelo ze-GRIT. Nceda uqinisekise kunobhala wenkundla.
strings.wa.help:
Ungabhala okanye uthumele umyalezo welizwi nangaliphi na ixesha. Ungathumela no:
{ask} {about}
{fill} ukuze ufumane uncedo lokugcwalisa isicelo sakho
{form} ukuze ubone isicelo sakho ukuza kuthi ga ngoku
{pdf} okanye {word} ukuze usifumane siluxwebhu
{language} ukuze utshintshe ulwimi
{delete} ukuze ucime le ncoko

Ukuba usengozini ngoku, fowunela amapolisa ku-10111 okanye i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (simahla, iiyure eziyi-24).
strings.wa.next:
Omawukwenze ngoku:
1. Thatha le fomu uyise kwi-clerk yenkundla, umntu onceda ngamaphepha enkundla, kuyo nayiphi na iMagistrates’ Court. Ukwenza isicelo kusimahla, kwaye awudingi gqwetha. Ukuba awukwazi ukuyiprinta, i-clerk ingakunceda.
2. Phatha i-ID yakho nayo nayiphi na into exhasa ibali lakho, njengeefoto, imiyalezo okanye iirekhodi zonyango.{missing}{bring}

Olu xwebhu ngoku lukwi-WhatsApp yakho kule fowuni. Ukuba kukho omnye umntu osebenzisa le fowuni, lucime kule ncoko xa sele unayo into oyidingayo. Ukucima le ncoko kwi-inFORMed, thumela {delete}.
strings.wa.nextMissing: 3. Okusekungekagcwaliswa kwifomu: {list}. Ungandixelela ngoku ndize ndongeze, okanye i-clerk yenkundla, umntu onceda ngamaphepha enkundla, ingakunceda.

strings.wa.textOnly: Ndiyakwazi ukufunda imiyalezo ebhaliweyo kunye nemiyalezo yelizwi. Nceda uchwetheze, okanye uthumele umyalezo welizwi.
strings.wa.voiceFail: Uxolo, andiwuvanga kakuhle loo myalezo welizwi. Nceda uzame kwakhona, okanye uchwetheze umyalezo wakho.
strings.welcomeBack: Wamkelekile kwakhona. Isicelo sakho sinjengokuba ubusishiye, kwaye ungasibona ngasekunene. Siza kuqhubeka? Ungandixelela nantoni na ongathanda ukuyongeza okanye ukuyitshintsha.
